## Orientation

Repo path (code only): `/home/andrewyin/se-workflow--phase-reviewer`. Commit on `phase/phase-reviewer` excluding `.artifacts`. Do not edit `.artifacts/` or call `adaptive-artifacts`. Parallel wave mate owns `agents/` and `scripts/sync-plugin.sh` — you own `se_workflow/` brief helper and `tests/test_phase_reviewer.py` (brief tests only). Do not edit `skills/execute-phase/SKILL.md`.

Requirements:
R2: The reviewer receives only task descriptions (including Approach goals), acceptance criteria, requirement/invariant text for structured work, and the phase diff/tree at phase head — not execution reports, check-runs, assessments, or builder notes. A test asserts the brief/prompt excludes those.

Design Invariants:
- Reviewer writes no store records.
- Single writer remains the parent.
- `done` tasks are not reopened; gaps are new fix tasks.

Design Assumptions:
- Host supports tool restriction for the reviewer agent; if Cursor cannot match Claude Code `agents/`, the skill documents the fallback and still forbids writes in the prompt.
- retry-loop fix-task and budget machinery is available when this phase executes (ordinal after retry-loop).

Decisions:
- reviewer-inputs: Specs, acceptances, invariants, and phase diff only; no builder self-grades
